stories.title: Judicial Ethics or Judicial Intimidation? DOJ Files Misconduct Complaint Against Nearly Every Federal Judge in Minnesota
stories.conservative_headline: Blanche Exposes Biased Judges Who Went on 'Partisan Press Tour' Against Trump Immigration Enforcement
stories.liberal_headline: Unprecedented: Trump's DOJ Moves to Sideline an Entire Federal Bench for Talking to Reporters
stories.poll_question: Was the DOJ right to file a misconduct complaint against the Minnesota judges?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Judges revealed partisan bias to reporters and should recuse from DHS cases.
stories.poll_option2_desc: DOJ is punishing judges for speaking truthfully about courtroom chaos.

stories.title: Power of the Purse or Pocket Veto? Trump's $810 Million Rescission Splits Even Republicans
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Takes Historic Action to Kill Wasteful Refugee and Bureaucracy Spending Before Fiscal Year Ends
stories.liberal_headline: Even Collins Calls It Illegal: White House Seizes Congress's Constitutional Spending Power
stories.poll_question: Can the president cancel funds Congress already approved?
stories.poll_option1_desc: President should stop spending on programs that fail taxpayers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Only Congress controls spending; this is illegal impoundment.

stories.title: Deport First or Due Process? Supreme Court Greenlights Third-Country Removals Over Liberal Dissent
stories.conservative_headline: SCOTUS Hands Trump Another Win: 'Bad Day for Criminal Illegals and Open Borders Activists'
stories.liberal_headline: Three Justices Dissent as Court Lets Trump Ship Migrants to Countries They've Never Seen
stories.poll_question: Should migrants be deported to countries they have no ties to?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Deportations shouldn't stall because a migrant objects to the destination.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Everyone deserves a chance to raise credible danger before removal.

stories.title: Taxpayer Propaganda or Public Service? Government-Funded Pro-Trump Ad Sparks Firestorm
stories.conservative_headline: Media Meltdown Over Upbeat Government Ad Celebrating America's Comeback
stories.liberal_headline: Your Tax Dollars Are Funding a Love Song to Donald Trump, and Nobody Will Say Who Paid
stories.poll_question: Is the government-funded pro-Trump ad legitimate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Administrations have always promoted their policies to the public.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Taxpayer money should never fund campaign-style praise of a president.

stories.title: Trimming Brass or Gutting Command? Hegseth Orders 20% Cut to Generals and Admirals

stories.poll_question: Is cutting 20% of senior military officers the right call?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Too many generals, too little warfighting focus. Streamline the Pentagon.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Stripping experienced commanders weakens readiness and politicizes the military.

stories.title: Innovation or Hands-Off Surrender? Speaker Johnson Rejects AI Rules After White House Tech Summit

stories.liberal_headline: Billionaires Dine at the White House While Congress Does Nothing About AI Breaching Federal Databases
stories.poll_question: Should Congress regulate artificial intelligence now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Industry standards beat red tape that hands the lead to China.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Self-policing failed; AI already threatens security and jobs.

stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Purge? SCOTUS Revives Citizenship Database Weeks Before Midterms

stories.poll_question: Should DHS use the SAVE database to check voter rolls?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Only citizens should vote; checking rolls protects every legal ballot.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Faulty data strips eligible Americans of their right to vote.

stories.title: Refund or Rebate Gimmick? $500 Obamacare Checks Start Hitting Mailboxes in 30 States

stories.poll_option1_desc: Money back to families who got nothing from Obamacare subsidies.
stories.poll_option2_desc: One-time checks mask double-digit premium increases hitting millions.

stories.title: Energy Dominance or Climate Betrayal? Trump Unveils $54 Billion South Korean Alaska LNG Deal

stories.title: Campus Accountability or Rush to Judgment? Hochul Demands Independent Review of Cornell Assault Case
